name: Terminal Knee Extension with Band
description: Terminal knee extension with a resistance band targets the final degrees of knee extension, emphasizing the vastus medialis oblique (VMO). A band is anchored behind the knee, and the exerciser extends the knee against the band's pull from a slightly flexed position. This exercise is widely used in knee rehabilitation protocols following injury or surgery to restore quadriceps activation and patellar tracking.

execution.starting_position: Anchor a resistance band to a fixed point behind you at knee height. Stand facing away and loop the band behind one knee. Begin with that knee slightly flexed, weight on the working leg.
execution.setup_instructions: Secure a resistance band at approximately knee height to a squat rack or door anchor. Stand far enough from the anchor that the band provides tension when the knee is at 15-20 degrees of flexion.
steps: Step 1: Stand facing away from the anchor with the band behind your knee, maintaining a slight forward lean if needed for balance.
Step 2: Begin with the knee bent approximately 20 degrees against band resistance.
Step 3: Contract the quadriceps to fully extend the knee to lockout, squeezing the VMO.
Step 4: Slowly return to the starting flexed position under control. Repeat.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale as you extend the knee to lockout. Inhale as you return to the flexed starting position.
common_mistakes: Allowing the knee to drift inward (valgus) during extension
Using momentum rather than controlled muscle contraction
Not fully extending to lockout — partial extension misses the VMO stimulus
safety_considerations: Consult a physiotherapist before using this exercise for post-surgical rehabilitation
Do not perform with acute joint swelling
Keep the movement slow and controlled throughout
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Work through approximately 20 degrees of flexion to full extension. Focus quality on the last 10-15 degrees where VMO activation peaks.
execution.tempo_recommendations: 2-0-2-1 (2s flex, no pause, 2s extend, 1s squeeze at lockout)
coaching_cues: Feel the inner quad contract at lockout
Drive the heel into the floor as you extend
Do not hyperextend the knee — stop at neutral
